tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Primary view background for plain (non-grouped) screens: Capture sheet, Inbox list, sign-in. Text: label, label-secondary.

tokens.name: background-secondary
tokens.usage: Groups and bands on top of background: section headers, search field well, composer strip.

tokens.name: background-tertiary
tokens.usage: Elements inside a secondary group on a plain screen: nested rows, inner panels.

tokens.name: grouped
tokens.usage: Page background for grouped (inset) screens: Focus, AI Review, Map, Decisions, Settings. Cards sit on it in grouped-secondary. Text: label, label-secondary.

tokens.name: grouped-secondary
tokens.usage: Cards and inset-grouped lists on grouped. This is the content layer: opaque, never glass.

tokens.name: grouped-tertiary
tokens.usage: Elements inside a grouped-secondary card: inner panels, step rows, option wells.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and glyphs on every background and grouped surface.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles, metadata, captions on background, grouped, grouped-secondary (4.5:1 or better in all themes). Apple's own value is 60% alpha, which measures below 4.5:1 on white; this is a solid, slightly darker equivalent.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Least important readable text: timestamps, helper footers. Do not use for anything the person must read to act.

tokens.name: label-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only. Exempt from contrast by definition; never carries information alone.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in empty fields on background-secondary and grouped-secondary.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline between rows and sections; may let content show through.

tokens.name: separator-opaque
tokens.usage: Hairline where the line must not show what is under it, and the one-pixel outline on hairline controls.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Fill behind sliders, switch tracks, chips in neutral state.

tokens.name: fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Segmented control track, search field fill on grouped.

tokens.name: fill-tertiary
tokens.usage: Pressed row, small neutral chip.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: The one interactive color: links, text buttons, selected tab, selected row mark, focus ring. Text on background and grouped-secondary at 4.5:1 or better. Apple's systemBlue is #007AFF; this is a slightly deeper blue so link-size text passes WCAG AA on white.

tokens.name: tint-fill
tokens.usage: Background of the single prominent button in a view (Approve, Done). Text on it: on-tint.

tokens.name: on-tint
tokens.usage: Label on tint-fill and on any filled status color. 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Fill and glyph color for a verified blocker or destructive action. Never text on white.

tokens.name: critical-text
tokens.usage: Text for blockers and destructive labels on background and grouped-secondary.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet banner or chip ground for blocker states; always paired with critical-text, the lock glyph and the word 'Blocked'.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Fill and glyph for 'needs your decision' and 'might be stale'. Never text on white.

tokens.name: caution-text
tokens.usage: Text for decision-needed and stale states on background and grouped-secondary.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet ground for decision-needed chips and banners; paired with caution-text and the 'Decision needed' wording.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Fill and glyph for done and ready. Never text on white.

tokens.name: positive-text
tokens.usage: Text for done and ready on background and grouped-secondary.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet ground for 'Ready' chips; paired with positive-text and the check glyph.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Fill and glyph that marks anything the AI suggested (sparkle mark, suggestion card rule). Distinct from tint so people can tell their content from proposals.

tokens.name: ai-text
tokens.usage: Text in AI-suggestion labels ('Suggested by AI') on background and grouped-secondary.

tokens.name: ai-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet ground behind an AI suggestion card header and its chips; paired with ai-text and the sparkle glyph.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Regular Liquid Glass tint for the controls layer only (tab bar, capture bar, toolbar buttons, floating buttons) over content. Pair with glass-edge and material blur. Never on cards or rows.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: One 1px light edge on glass elements.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind a modal sheet or alert, and the optional 35% dark dim under clear glass.

tokens.name: material-thin
tokens.usage: Thin standard material: content-layer headers that must show scrolled content, not controls. Use with backdrop blur 20px.

tokens.name: material-regular
tokens.usage: Regular standard material: sidebar background on Mac and iPad, popovers. Use with backdrop blur 30px.

tokens.name: material-thick
tokens.usage: Thick standard material: sheets' header when scrolled, menus. Use with backdrop blur 40px.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Top of each tab's root screen only (Mission Status, Inbox). Emphasized: weight 700.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Section titles in full-screen detail and the current priority.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Sheet titles, card titles for a priority.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, button labels, nav bar title (inline).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading and capture text. Inbox rows use this.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Supporting sentences inside cards: AI reasoning.

styles.name: caption-1
styles.usage: Chips, dependency type labels, tab bar label (rendered 10-11px by the system).

styles.name: caption-2
styles.usage: Smallest permitted text on iOS; badges and timestamps only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips; hairline stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; vertical gap between stacked rows in a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding extra; gap between a title and its subtitle block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen margin on iPhone (compact width); card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen margin on iPad and Mac (regular width); gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; sheet content padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a large-title block; empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Mac content max inset; hero spacing.

tokens.name: hit
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target (iOS 44x44 pt; Mac pointer 28pt). Every control's hit area, even when the glyph is smaller.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum list row height (one line); two-line rows grow to content.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox squares, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text fields inside groups, small panels.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inset-grouped list corner and inner panels inside cards (22 card minus 8 inset).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards: Mission Status priority card, AI suggestion card.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets on iPhone (top corners), large floating panels. Concentric: sheet 34 holds cards 22 with 12 inset.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsules: buttons, chips, tab bar, capture bar, segmented control. Radius is half the height.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Grouped cards barely lift in light; in dark the surface step does the work (grouped-secondary on grouped).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Glass controls layer: tab bar, capture bar, floating buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Modal sheet edge.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: Label opacity of a plain/text button while pressed.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Whole-control opacity when disabled; also say why in text.
